working_classification: Railway accepted the deployment while the application process was not reachable on the configured service path/port. Treat as runtime/configuration/observability until process-level evidence proves a product defect.
containment: Do not treat Railway deployment SUCCESS as customer-proof readiness.
Block customer-proof or sell-readiness claims while the exact deployed service health probe is non-green.
Do not reuse the 0.6.70 staging service as evidence for the frozen 0.6.76 candidate.
Preserve the failed HTTP evidence and avoid blind redeploy/restart while root cause is unverified.
verification_required: exact candidate identity matches deployment manifest and runtime SHA
three independent /api/health probes return 200 with the expected healthy body
no connection-dial-timeout evidence during the verification window
authenticated customer journey succeeds before customer-proof readiness is claimed

related_blocker.github_actions_blocker: RAILWAY_TOKEN repository secret is not configured

learning: Deployment control-plane success is not liveness evidence. Promotion/readiness must require independent runtime health tied to the exact candidate identity, and a missing deployment credential is a configuration blocker rather than a product defect.
claim_boundary: This incident records read-only staging evidence. No Railway service, customer state, production resource or credential was mutated.
